sentences: An oriented spanner provides short directed closed walks through every pair of points.
The benchmark for a pair is the perimeter of its smallest containing triangle, not simply twice its straight-line distance.
The source asks whether every point set admits an orientation with worst-case dilation strictly below two.
The question initially allows complete oriented graphs, so sparsity is not the first obstacle.
The later source stored with TCS-1212 achieves a factor of five thirds, so this historical target should be read alongside that stronger result.
